Compute tree above ground biomass (AGB) using (multiple) user biomass allometry

Source: R/computeAGB_myallom.R
computeAGB_myallom.Rd

Compute tree above ground biomass (AGB) using (multiple) user biomass allometry

Usage

computeAGB_myallom(allometry, ...)

Arguments

allometry

a function which returns AGB estimates as a numeric vector, or a list of functions

...

arguments passed to function(s) provided in allometry

Value

numeric vector with tree AGB estimates

Examples

allom <- function(D, G) {
  D*G
}
allom2 <- function(G) {
  G^2
}

d <- c(10:99)
g <- c(100:189)

computeAGB_myallom(list(allom, allom2), D = d, G = g)
